display.text:
import pytest

from todo.storage import TodoStore


def test_add_assigns_incrementing_ids(tmp_path):
    store = TodoStore(tmp_path / "t.json")
    assert store.add("a")["id"] == 1
    assert store.add("b")["id"] == 2


def test_list_returns_added_todos(tmp_path):
    store = TodoStore(tmp_path / "t.json")
    store.add("a")
    assert [t["text"] for t in store.list()] == ["a"]


def test_complete_marks_done(tmp_path):
    store = TodoStore(tmp_path / "t.json")
    store.add("a")
    assert store.complete(1)["done"] is True


def test_remove_deletes_todo(tmp_path):
    store = TodoStore(tmp_path / "t.json")
    store.add("a")
    store.add("b")
    store.remove(1)
    assert [t["text"] for t in store.list()] == ["b"]


def test_remove_missing_id_raises_keyerror(tmp_path):
    store = TodoStore(tmp_path / "t.json")
    store.add("a")
    with pytest.raises(KeyError):
        store.remove(99)
    assert [t["text"] for t in store.list()] == ["a"]


def test_add_defaults_to_medium_priority(tmp_path):
    store = TodoStore(tmp_path / "t.json")
    assert store.add("a")["priority"] == "medium"


def test_add_stores_given_priority(tmp_path):
    store = TodoStore(tmp_path / "t.json")
    store.add("a", priority="high")
    assert store.list()[0]["priority"] == "high"


def test_add_invalid_priority_raises_valueerror(tmp_path):
    store = TodoStore(tmp_path / "t.json")
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        store.add("a", priority="urgent")
    assert store.list() == []
